title: Halcyon: incident and defense
intro: The admin account was used at 3 a.m. Now you are the defender: trace the intrusion, watch for the next one and build the defenses.
outro: Halcyon is safe for now. You traced the intruder and defended the network against everything that came next.
r1.story: Halcyon's admin account was used at 3 a.m. Find who did it in the authentication log.
r2.story: A quiet intrusion hides in the noise. Spot it in the queue.
r3.story: The attacker from the incident is back. Protect Halcyon in the queue.
r4.story: Defend the small network Halcyon started with.
r5.story: You know the intruder and the method. Defend the whole Halcyon network against what comes next.
